name: Readability Complexity Collapse (Calibration)
description: Calibration variant. Pure-Python readability feature extraction (avg sentence len, word len, type-token ratio, punct density, long-word ratio) + MiniBatchKMeans complexity clustering → MiniLM embeddings → collapse to ONNX topic-map student. No ML model downloads; zero external dependencies beyond standard library. Tests whether lexical/structural complexity signal produces stable collapse behavior.
